title: Actual positive quotient module tower
statement: Put R=ULift(Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E). The category of strict R-module towers is the functor category from the opposite natural-number poset to ModuleCat R. The actual quotient tower has term R/(uniformizer^(n+1)), with its quotient R action, and successor map the quotient-linear reduction. It is constructed by Functor.ofOpSequence, and its degree-zero complex is the coefficient target used by the mapping-tower comparison. This node records only these existing constructions, not the natural-currying theorem in their source module.
